ITEM TEXT
Research
has
shown
that
the
gut
microbiome
is
important
for
human
physiology
and
health
.
Disturbances
to
the
composition
of
the
gut
microbiome
can
be
associated
with
chronic
diseases
such
as
gastrointestinal
inflammatory
disorders
,
and
neurological
,
cardiovascular
and
respiratory
illnesses
.
The
human
body
has
evolved
strategies
to
ensure
that
a
symbiotic
relationship
exists
between
the
microbes
in
our
gut
and
our
cells
.
